note: Adapted from Emerson’s 1952 original English description; the new species is described from a single soldier (the holotype, from Santa Amélia, Brazil). Measurements translated verbatim from Table 25 of the original, in millimetres. The original did not describe the alate or the worker.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Among the species of the genus with a short hair blanket on the head, all the others have straighter and more parallel sides of the head and a sharper transition between the sides and the posterior margin; in this species the sides are curved and narrowed anteriorly, with a smooth transition between them.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head, pronotum and abdomen pale yellow. Head with many setae and covered with a short hair blanket; front of the postmentum with a few setae and covered with short hairs; pronotum with many setae and a few short hairs on the anterior margin; tergites with setae; sternites with hairs and setae. Sides of the head curved and narrowed anteriorly. Frontal tube short, its tip covering the base of the postclypeus from above. Narrowest part of the postmentum slightly wider than half the greatest width (15:26). Antennae 15-segmented, segments 2, 3 and 4 about equal in length. Sides of the labrum slightly angular, the white tip broad and rounded. Apex of the left mandible rather elongate, slightly serrate in front of the notch, the notch rather deep, with 1 distinct tooth and coarse serrations behind it. Margin of the right mandible in front of the notch evenly curved (not S-shaped), the notch angle about 60—70°. Anterior margin of the pronotum distinctly concave. Measurements (mm; original Table 25, single holotype): head length including mandibles 5.12; head length to the tip of the frontal tube 3.38; head length to the lateral mandibular bases 3.47; head width 3.12; head thickness 2.03; frontal tube length 0.34; labrum width 0.87; left mandible length 1.78; right mandible length from the notch 0.96; pronotum length 0.85; pronotum width 1.53; hind tibia length 2.41.
